ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Georgia Gwinnett College (fall 2024 admissions, enrollment, campus setting: Suburb: Large)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions counts and nonresident-alien undergraduates (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator; exact counts from the NCES IPEDS ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal): 6,153 applied (2,416 men, 3,737 women), 5,876 admitted, 2,612 enrolled. GGC lists a 2025 Fall Semester Common Data Set, but its page and files block automated access (HTTP 403) and the Wayback copy was rate-limited, so no CDS figures (international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT/ACT percentiles, factors) are included. IPEDS shows no SAT/ACT score ranges for GGC (test-optional). International undergraduates (481) are IPEDS fall 2024 nonresident aliens, about 3.9% of 12,230 undergraduates.
